description: This file defines a Flask blueprint for a minimal chat API endpoint. It handles POST requests to '/api/chat', validates the input JSON payload, checks provider support, and interfaces with a Gemini service to generate chat replies, handling various error scenarios.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: A service class responsible for interacting with the Gemini AI API to generate chat responses.

classes.name: GeminiConfigurationError
classes.description: Exception class for configuration-related issues with the Gemini API.

classes.name: GeminiProviderError
classes.description: Exception class for errors returned by the Gemini provider during API requests.

methods.name: tuple[Any,int]|Any chat()
methods.description: Handles POST requests to the '/api/chat' endpoint, processes user message input, calls Gemini API, and returns the reply or error information.
